name: Opera Australia Student Rush tickets
summary: Same-day $35 Student Rush opera tickets for full-time students at Australian institutions, on selected performances.
key: With appropriate ID, you can buy a $35 ticket from 9am on the day of selected performances.
who: Full-time students at an Australian institution, with student ID.
how: Visit the production's web page from 9am on the day and select the 'Student Rush' ticket.
Bring your student ID to the box office to collect your tickets.
catches: Seat can be anything from B Reserve to restricted view.
Booking window is 9am to noon or until sold out; a $9.80 transaction fee applies.
